title: Vortex Download Manager v1.0.5
changelog: Clean Vector Icons: Replaced all OS button and header emojis with crisp anti-aliased vector QIcon components (Pause, Resume, Stop, Turbo Lightning, Clock, Heart)
Eliminated Label Outlines: Scoped card frames and removed cascaded Qt QLabel border outlines across all telemetry metrics and status badges
Dynamic 16-Sector Download Levels: Enhanced real-time rising sector fill bars from bottom-to-top with compact speed indicators (1.2M, 921K)
Turbo Color Telemetry: Visualized Turbo Mode workload splits in emerald green-to-amber gradient and standard sockets in vibrant purple
Instant In-Flight Turbo Toggle: Dynamic mid-stream socket management toggles Turbo helper processes without restarting or stalling active downloads
Comprehensive Anti-Virus Cleanliness: Embedded PE version resources, signed metadata, and zero third-party script triggers for 100% clean AV analysis
